source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: Use natural acid-base indicators to infer the nature of an unknown substance from colour changes.
node_labels: Matter: materials, particles, mixtures and change

intelligence.enrichment: A prepared natural indicator gives a response pattern in acidic or basic media, so the observed colour after adding a sample is evidence for the sample's nature. sample_nature -> natural_indicator_colour_response -> inferred_label student says flowers are used because they are colourful but gives no link between rose extract and lemon or soap tests

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 7 Science question. Chapter: Acids, bases and salts. The student must decide: Use natural acid-base indicators to infer the nature of an unknown substance from colour changes. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE. If the stem numbers activities 1..n, every number must appear in an option (or in a structured part's first-class options). Two-tier (choose, then reason) is welcome: put A/B/C on part.options, not typed into part text.
